sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Rune names a non-Celtic alphabet. People sometimes misapply the word to the Ogham alphabet. It fits better the early script of Scandinavia. Folklorists also use it for a verse charm that rhymes.

okr.objective: The rune is a non-Celtic alphabet term.
